title: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple, Varanasi - A Sanctuary of Faith, Strength & Blessings
content:
Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple, Varanasi

Sankat Mochan Temple is one of the most revered and visited temples in Varanasi, dedicated to Lord Hanuman, the remover of troubles (Sankat Mochan).
Located near Assi, this sacred temple was established by the great poet-saint Goswami Tulsidas, the author of the Ramcharitmanas.
Devotees believe that offering prayers here removes obstacles, grants peace, and brings protection from negativity.

History & Significance

The temple holds a deep connection with the life of Tulsidas.
According to legend, Lord Hanuman appeared to him at this very spot, inspiring him to build a temple.
Since then, Sankat Mochan Temple has become a powerful place of devotion, known for its calm environment and strong spiritual vibration.

Thousands of devotees come daily to offer laddoo prasad, chant Hanuman Chalisa, and seek blessings for protection, courage, and good health.
The temple is also famous for its Tuesday and Saturday crowds, considered especially auspicious for Hanuman worship.

What to See at Sankat Mochan Temple

1. Main Hanuman Shrine: The idol of Lord Hanuman is in a meditative posture facing Lord Rama. Devotees offer sindoor, flowers, and laddoos.

2. Peaceful Temple Complex: The temple has a simple yet powerful aura. Sitting here during evening aarti feels deeply calming.

3. Daily Aarti & Hanuman Chalisa Recitations: Morning and evening aartis fill the temple with devotional energy. Continuous recitations of the Hanuman Chalisa create a strong spiritual atmosphere.

4. Sankat Mochan Sangeet Samaroh: A famous classical music festival held every April where renowned artists perform for free as an offering to Lord Hanuman.

Best Time to Visit

  • Early morning for peaceful darshan
  • Evening aarti for devotional vibes
  • Tuesdays & Saturdays if you want to experience strong spiritual energy (but expect more crowd)

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Assi Ghat
  • Durga Temple (Durga Kund)
  • Tulsi Ghat
  • Tulsi Manas Temple
  • Banaras Hindu University (BHU)
